'''2024 Charity Brad Kippel DS HD''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brad Kippel]] at the [[2024 Online Retro Event for Charity]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Brad Kippel]]
* '''Event:''' [[2024 Online Retro Event for Charity]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Format:''' [[Classic (no v-cards)|Classic No-V]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' [[Prepared Defenses]]
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:2024-retro-24Retro Kippel DS HD.txt|Download]]
